summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Platform Enhancement Specification for Revivedu educational portal. All major features successfully implemented including persistent header navigation, dashboard with calendar widget and streak tracking, difficulty selector in activity generator, enhanced activity detail page with edit/print/download functionality, and improved feedback system with Likert scale and learning outcomes checklist.
passed_tests: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns all required fields (total_activities, total_artifacts, total_feedbacks, activity_dates, current_streak, longest_streak)
PATCH /api/activities/{id} successfully updates activity title
POST /api/activities/generate accepts difficulty parameter (easy/medium/difficult)
POST /api/feedback accepts completion_status and outcomes_achieved fields
User authentication and child profile creation working
Header shows persistent navigation links after login (Home, Dashboard, Generate Activity, Library, Guide)
Dashboard displays calendar widget with activity dates highlighted
Dashboard displays current streak and best streak information
Activity Generator has difficulty selector with Easy/Medium/Difficult options
Activity Detail has edit title button with save functionality
Activity Detail has Print and Download PDF buttons
Feedback tab renamed to 'Activity Feedback & Learner Engagement'
Feedback form has completion status dropdown (Completed/Partially Completed/Not Engaged)
Feedback form has 1-5 Likert scale rating system
Feedback form has learning outcomes checklist functionality
Artifacts tab renamed to 'What did they make?'
Activity title update functionality working correctly
All existing API endpoints functioning properly
Frontend navigation and routing working correctly
Enhanced feedback system fully functional
